en.topic_title: Migrant domestic workers demand 21% wage hike to HK$6,172, reject calls for pay freeze
en.topic_summary:
Domestic workers called for an increase in their Minimum Allowable Wage from HK$5,100 to HK$6,172 at a rally outside the Labour Department on Friday.



Domestic workers demand an increase to the Minimum Allowable Wage outside the Labour Department on September 25, 2026. Photo: AMCB.



The Asian Migrants Coordinating Body (AMCB) also called for an increase in the monthly food allowance from HK$1,236 to HK$3,123. Employers must provide free meals or pay the food allowance set by the Labour Depar
